\[

\]
so
\[

\[
\cos\theta=\frac{r-R}{2}.

\[
M^2=|\alpha|^2=|a|^2=|x-1|^2=r^2+1-2r\cos\theta.

\[
M^2=r^2+1-r(r-R)=Rr+1=99+1=100.
\]
Thus \(M=10\). Existence: \(\alpha=10,\ \beta=-10\) satisfy the equation, so the only possible value is
\[
\boxed{10}
\]
